kebab_example: aliyun eas update-service-rollout --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name my-service --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServiceRollout

parameters.help_en:
The region ID where the service is located.

Type: string

Required: Yes

Description: The ID of the region where the service is located.

Example: cn-shanghai
parameters.help_zh:
ClusterId  
类型: string
必填: 是
说明: 地域ID。服务所在的地域标识。
示例值: cn-shanghai
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the service.

Type: string

Required: Yes

Description: The name of the service for which to update the release policy.

Example: my-service
parameters.help_zh:
ServiceName  
类型: string
必填: 是
说明: 服务名称。要更新发布策略的服务名称。
示例值: my-service
parameters.name: service_name

fields.help_en: The number of replicas to update in each batch. This can be an integer or a percentage. The default is `"25%"`
fields.help_zh: 批次大小。每批次更新的副本数量。支持整数或百分比格式。默认值：`"25%"`
fields.name: batch_size

fields.help_en: The interval to wait between batches. Supported units include `s` (seconds), `m` (minutes), and `h` (hours)
fields.help_zh: 批次间隔。两次发布之间的等待时间。支持单位：`s`（秒）、`m`（分钟）、`h`（小时）
fields.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The batch rollout configuration. This parameter is mutually exclusive with `Partition`.

Type: object

Required: No

Description: The batch rollout configuration for adjusting batch policy parameters. This parameter is mutually exclusive with Partition
parameters.help_zh:
Batch  
类型: object
必填: 否
说明: 批量发布配置。用于调整批量策略参数。与Partition互斥
parameters.name: batch

fields.help_en:
Partition value

Type: string

Required: Yes

Description: The partition value. This parameter specifies the number or percentage of old-version replicas to retain. It supports two formats:

An integer, such as "5", for the number of replicas.

A percentage, such as "50%", for the proportion of replicas.

  Adjustment strategy:

Increasing the value rolls back to the previous version by increasing the number of old-version replicas.

Decreasing the value continues the rollout by reducing the number of old-version replicas.

Setting the value to "0" or "0%" completes the rollout, replacing all old-version replicas.

Example: 30%
fields.help_zh:
Partition  
类型: string
必填: 是
说明: 分区值。支持两种格式：
整数格式：如 "5"，表示保留5个旧副本
百分比格式：如 "50%"，表示保留50%的旧副本
  调整策略：
调大值：回退到旧版本，增加旧副本比例
调小值：推进到新版本，减少旧副本比例
设置为"0%"：完成全部更新，所有副本切换到新版本
示例值: 30%
fields.name: partition

parameters.help_en:
The partition rollout configuration. This parameter is mutually exclusive with `Batch`.

Type: object

Required: No

Description: The partition rollout configuration. This parameter adjusts the parameters for the partition strategy. It is mutually exclusive with `Batch`
parameters.help_zh:
Partition  
类型: object
必填: 否
说明: 分区发布配置。用于调整分区策略参数。与Batch互斥
parameters.name: partition

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to pause the rollout or `false` to resume it
parameters.help_zh: 是否暂停发布。`true`表示暂停，`false`表示恢复
parameters.name: paused
